data.one_liner: A bottom sheet widget that expands upward as the user scrolls.
data.what_it_does: Provides a slinky-like panel that aligns to the bottom of a widget and responds to drag and scroll gestures. It includes a mask layer for the body and allows configuring size bounds, rounded corners, and scroll animations.
use_when: You need a bottom sheet panel that interacts with vertical scroll content
You want a panel that expands upwards when scrolled and masks the background body
avoid_when: You need standard material modal bottom sheets without scroll expansion behavior
You are not using Sliver widgets inside the panel contents
strengths: Easy to configure with controllers and parameters
Supports customizable max/min sizes and border radius
Includes barrier dismissal and masking out of the box
weaknesses: Panel contents strictly require Sliver widgets
Very limited documentation beyond basic examples
